title: The Old Dungeon — Floor 1
entrance_text: The dungeon entrance is a crack in the hillside that the old city used as a quarry before the Fracture changed the stone.
Inside, the air is cold and smells of damp earth. Bioluminescent fungi cling to the walls, casting everything in pale blue-green light.
Your System compass pulses — RANK F ZONE. Proceed with appropriate caution.
Something skitters in the darkness ahead.

root.text: You stand at the dungeon's entrance corridor. The path splits — a wide tunnel to the left where you can hear goblin chatter, and a narrow passage to the right that the System's compass marks as 'unmapped'. Ahead is a chamber with something glowing.

options.label: Take the wide tunnel. Fight the goblins.
The goblin tunnel is cleared. Search the area.
Take the narrow unmapped passage. See what the System doesn't know about.
Revisit the unmapped passage.
Move toward the glowing chamber.
Search the entrance area for crafting materials.
Talk to Pell, the vendor at the entrance.
Both threats are down. Report Floor 1 cleared to the Guild survey post.
Return to the village. Not ready yet.

floor1_cleared.text:
The survey post is a brass plate bolted to the wall by the entrance, humming with System light. You press your palm to it.

FLOOR 1 THREATS: NEUTRALISED. SURVEY CONFIRMED. ADVENTURER RANK: F → E.

A second line scrolls beneath, smaller: ROAD PERMIT GRANTED — VERATH. The guards on the capital road will let you through now.

options.label: Good. Head back into the corridor.

goblin_scout_node.text:
You edge to the tunnel entrance and peer in. The fungal light is bright enough to see clearly.

Three goblins are crouched over a stolen adventurer's pack: two wiry Goblin Scouts flanking the entrance, and a heavier Goblin Looter in the center gripping a rusty cleaver. They haven't noticed you yet.

The Looter looks tougher — higher HP, hits harder. The Scouts are faster. You have a moment to plan your approach.

options.label: Charge in — fight all three! [Goblin Scout x2 + Goblin Looter]
Try to sneak past them quietly.

after_goblins.text:
The goblin tunnel is quiet now. The System pulses: EXPERIENCE GAINED.

Among the debris you spot the stolen adventurer's pack.

options.label: Check what's in the stolen pack.
The pack is already empty — you searched it last time.
Leave the pack. Continue exploring.

stolen_pack.text:
Inside the pack: a health potion, some rations, and — oddly — a leather-bound book with no title. The pages appear blank at first, but when you hold it under the fungal light, text appears and vanishes like smoke.

The System produces no notification. None. It has nothing to say about this object.

Also in the pack, half-buried under torn canvas: a smithing hammer. Heavy, balanced, with a double-lobe stamp mark on the head and a V between the lobes.

options.label: Take everything — the book and the hammer.
Take the hammer. Leave the unclassified book.
Take the health potion. Leave everything else.

sneak_success.text:
You slip past the goblins in utter silence. They never know you were there.

The System notes this with what almost feels like surprise.

options.label: Continue deeper.

unmapped_passage.text:
The passage narrows until you have to turn sideways. The System's compass shows a blinking question mark.

Deep in the dark, you find a small alcove. Sitting on a natural stone shelf is a shard of something black and crystalline that seems to eat light rather than reflect it.

The System produces no notification. None. It has nothing to say about this object.

options.label: Take the void shard.
Leave it. You don't touch things the System can't explain.
The alcove is empty — you already claimed the shard.

unmapped_revisit.text:
The narrow passage is quiet. The alcove where the void shard sat is empty — a dark smudge on the stone where it rested for years, maybe decades.

Nothing else here. But you notice the rock wall at the back has faint tool marks. Someone carved this alcove deliberately.

options.label: Study the tool marks more carefully.
Head back to the main corridor.

crystal_chamber.text:
The chamber is lit by a cluster of blue crystals growing from the ceiling. At its center: a stone platform with a softly glowing mana crystal the size of your fist.

This is clearly a resource node — the Guild would pay well for confirmed locations.

options.label: Investigate the web-covered alcove. [Crystal Spiders]
Mark the location for the Guild survey.
Location already marked. The crystal pulses steadily.
Take the mana crystal for yourself.
The platform is empty — you already took the crystal.
Find the stairs to Floor 2.

floor2_warning.text:
You find the staircase leading down. The System pings a warning: RANK MISMATCH DETECTED. RANK F ADVENTURER. FLOOR 2 CREATURES: RANK C. PROCEEDING IS INADVISABLE.

The stairs descend into darkness. You can hear... something large, moving.

options.label: Retreat. The Guild was right.
Descend anyway. You need to understand what's changed.

herb_foraging.text: Near the dungeon entrance, patches of glowing fungi and hardy medicinal herbs grow where light filters in from the cracks above. The damp stone floor is riddled with root systems. A crafter's eye would find useful material here.

options.label: Forage for herbs and materials.
Check if anything has regrown. [Needs 10 turns to respawn]
Head back inside.
